arguments.summary: Build at C++23: rename Manifest::requires (a C++20 keyword) to requirements, make ParseOptions an aggregate again, cast the returned parameter in as_lvalue, use std::invoke_result_t, write the tree's box-drawing prefixes as plain UTF-8 literals, and capture this explicitly.
review_notes: Public API: Manifest::requires is now Manifest::requirements, since requires is a keyword in C++20; the manifest text format still uses the key "requires".
ParseOptions lost its defaulted constructor to stay an aggregate in C++20; its default member values are unchanged, so ParseOptions{} still means strict = false, max_requires = 64.
